Pass multiple Tesseract language codes as a list

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\",\"deu\",\"fra\"]}}")
```
